text:
Devon Toews already has 16 points in 18 games. Last season he had 24 in 68. Something has changed, and some of it is real: Colorado takes 59% of expected goals at 5-on-5 with him on, nine points better than without him, and Yahoo Sports framed his start as a reminder there's more to the Avalanche defense than Cale Makar.

The rest is bounces. The Avs have scored 7.8 more goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice, and he is shooting 14.7%, far above the typical defenseman's 6.5%. On-ice luck like that fades, and his points per 60 sit well above the range our numbers expect.

Still, there is a player under it. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 6.9 primary shot assists per 60 last season, 96th percentile among defensemen, and Evolving-Hockey had him driving play at the 94th percentile, with the caveat that his teammates are among the best in the league. Our range has him at 37 to 56 points.
headline: Toews has 16 points. The bounces gave him plenty
